issues.title: Ingest the Arlington County budget
issues.learned: FY2027 General Fund $1,024,492,896 across 30 departments — Human Services ($214.8M) and Environmental Services ($130.4M) lead. The county also transfers ~$838M to the schools; all-funds county budget $2.24B. The appropriations resolution foots to the dollar.

issues.title: Ingest schools and other funds
issues.detail: The ~$838M schools transfer and other operating funds are the next branch.
